description.sk: Klasika zo Slovenska: mäkké zemiakové halušky obalené v ovčej bryndzi a chrumkavej slanine.
description.en: A Slovak classic: soft potato dumplings tossed in sheep's cheese and crispy bacon.

steps.sk: Daj variť veľký hrniec osolenej vody.
steps.en: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na kocky a opeč na suchej panvici do chrumkava, asi 8 minút. Odlož ju aj s výpekom.
steps.en: Dice the bacon and fry it in a dry pan until crisp, about 8 minutes. Set it aside with the fat.

steps.sk: Zemiaky najemno nastrúhaj a zmiešaj s vajcom, soľou a múkou na husté lepkavé cesto. Ak je riedke, pridaj trochu múky.
steps.en: Finely grate the potatoes and mix with the egg, salt and flour into a thick, sticky dough. Add a little more flour if it is runny.

steps.sk: Cesto pretláčaj cez haluškár alebo ho z dosky odrezávaj nožom priamo do vriacej vody. Keď halušky vyplávajú na povrch, var ich ešte 2 minúty.
steps.en: Press the dough through a spaetzle maker or scrape small pieces off a board straight into the boiling water. Once the dumplings float, cook them for 2 more minutes.

steps.sk: Halušky vyber dierovanou naberačkou a hneď ich zmiešaj s bryndzou a lyžicou vody z varenia.
steps.en: Lift the dumplings out with a slotted spoon and immediately mix them with the bryndza and a spoonful of the cooking water.

steps.sk: Posyp slaninou, polej výpekom a podľa chuti pažítkou. Podávaj hneď, tradične s kyslým mliekom.
steps.en: Top with the bacon and its fat and, if you like, chives. Serve right away, traditionally with a glass of buttermilk.

title.en: Sauerkraut soup with sausage and mushrooms

description.sk: Hustá, údená a kyslastá polievka, ktorá na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
description.en: A thick, smoky and tangy soup that tastes even better the next day.

steps.sk: Sušené hríby zalej v miske 200 ml horúcej vody a nechaj ich 15 minút napučať.
steps.en: Cover the dried mushrooms with 200 ml hot water and let them soak for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej olej, speň na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a potom opeč mäso zo všetkých strán, asi 6 minút.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pot, soften the finely chopped onion, then brown the pork on all sides, about 6 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj papriku a rascu, hneď zalej 1,5 l vody a pridaj kyslú kapustu aj so šťavou, bobkové listy a hríby aj s vodou.
steps.en: Stir in the paprika and caraway, then immediately add 1.5 l water, the sauerkraut with its juice, the bay leaves and the mushrooms with their soaking water.

steps.sk: Var prikryté 40 minút, kým nie je mäso mäkké a ľahko sa rozpadá.
steps.en: Simmer covered for 40 minutes, until the pork is tender and falls apart easily.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky a klobásu nakrájané na kocky a var ďalších 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the diced potatoes and sausage and simmer for another 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Múku rozmiešaj v troche studenej vody, vlej do polievky, osoľ, okoreň a povar ešte 5 minút. Podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany.
steps.en: Whisk the flour into a little cold water, stir it into the soup, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 5 more minutes. Serve with a spoonful of sour cream.

title.en: Lentil stew with a fried egg

description.sk: Lacný a sýty prívarok s jemne sladkokyslou chuťou, doplnený vajíčkom.
description.en: A cheap, filling lentil stew with a gentle sweet-sour note, topped with a fried egg.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni, zalej 1 l vody, pridaj bobkové listy a var 25 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils, cover with 1 l water, add the bay leaves and simmer for 25 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Medzitým na 2 lyžiciach oleja speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, pridaj múku a za stáleho miešania praž do svetlohneda, asi 3 minúty.
steps.en: Meanwhile, soften the finely chopped onion in 2 tablespoons of oil, add the flour and cook, stirring, until light brown, about 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Zápražku vmiešaj do šošovice, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán, soľ, ocot a cukor. Povar 5 minút, kým prívarok nezhustne.
steps.en: Stir the roux into the lentils, add the crushed garlic, marjoram, salt, vinegar and sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji usmaž volské oká, kým bielky nestuhnú a žĺtky sú ešte tekuté, asi 3 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny, about 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Prívarok dochuť octom a soľou a podávaj s vajíčkom a chlebom.
steps.en: Adjust the vinegar and salt and serve with the egg and bread.

title.sk: Zemiakové placky s cesnakom a majoránom
title.en: Potato pancakes with garlic and marjoram

description.sk: Chrumkavé placky z pár surovín, ktoré má doma takmer každý.
description.en: Crispy pancakes made from a handful of things almost everyone has at home.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, najemno nastrúhaj a v čistej utierke z nich vytlač čo najviac vody.
steps.en: Peel and finely grate the potatoes, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a clean tea towel.

steps.sk: Primiešaj vajcia, múku, prelisovaný cesnak, majorán, soľ a korenie.
steps.en: Mix in the eggs, flour, crushed garlic, marjoram, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja, naber cesto lyžicou a roztlač ho na tenké placky.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan, spoon in the batter and spread it into thin pancakes.

steps.sk: Smaž ich na strednom ohni 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany do zlatista a chrumkava. Olej podľa potreby dolievaj.
steps.en: Fry over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and crisp, adding more oil as needed.

steps.sk: Placky nechaj odkvapkať na papierovej utierke a podávaj teplé, napríklad s kyslou smotanou.
steps.en: Drain on kitchen paper and serve warm, for example with sour cream.

description.sk: Šťavnaté kuracie stehná v krémovej paprikovej omáčke.
description.en: Juicy chicken thighs in a creamy paprika sauce.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a na oleji ju pomaly speň do zlatista, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Finely chop the onions and cook them slowly in the oil until golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Stiahni hrniec z ohňa a vmiešaj papriku – nesmie sa pripáliť, lebo by zhorkla. Pridaj mäso nakrájané na väčšie kusy.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika; it turns bitter if it burns. Add the chicken cut into large pieces.

steps.sk: Pridaj nakrájanú papriku a paradajku, osoľ, podlej 200 ml vody a nechaj prikryté dusiť 25 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a pri prepichnutí z neho vyteká číra šťava (vnútri 75 °C).
steps.en: Add the chopped pepper and tomato, season with salt, pour in 200 ml water and braise covered for 25 minutes, until the chicken is tender and its juices run clear (75 °C inside).

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar cestoviny podľa návodu na obale.
steps.en: Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the packet.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s múkou, vmiešaj do omáčky a za stáleho miešania povar 3 minúty.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour, stir it into the sauce and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring.

steps.sk: Podávaj paprikáš s cestovinami.
steps.en: Serve the paprikash with the pasta.

title.en: Garlic soup with cheese and croutons

description.sk: Rýchla zahrievacia polievka, ktorá postaví na nohy.
description.en: A quick warming soup that perks you right up.

steps.sk: Zemiaky nakrájaj na malé kocky, zalej 1,2 l vody, pridaj bujón a rascu a var 15 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Dice the potatoes, cover with 1.2 l water, add the stock cube and caraway and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky a opeč na oleji dochrumkava.
steps.en: Cut the bread into cubes and toast them in the oil until crisp.

steps.sk: Do polievky pridaj maslo, prelisovaný cesnak a majorán, osoľ a už len krátko prehrej, aby cesnak nestratil arómu.
steps.en: Add the butter, crushed garlic and marjoram to the soup, season with salt and only heat it through briefly so the garlic keeps its aroma.

steps.sk: Do tanierov daj strúhaný syr a krutóny a zalej ich horúcou polievkou.
steps.en: Put grated cheese and croutons into the bowls and ladle the hot soup over them.

description.sk: Nadýchané kysnuté lievance na víkendové raňajky.
description.en: Fluffy yeasted pancakes for a weekend breakfast.

steps.sk: Mlieko zohrej len do vlažna (nie nahorúco) a rozmiešaj v ňom cukor a droždie.
steps.en: Warm the milk until just lukewarm (not hot) and stir in the sugar and yeast.

steps.sk: V mise zmiešaj múku so soľou, pridaj vajcia a mlieko a vymiešaj hladké husté cesto.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the salt in a bowl, add the eggs and milk and beat into a smooth, thick batter.

steps.sk: Prikry utierkou a nechaj na teplom mieste kysnúť 30 minút, kým nezdvojnásobí objem.
steps.en: Cover with a tea towel and leave in a warm place to rise for 30 minutes, until doubled.

steps.sk: Panvicu jemne potri olejom, nalievaj malé kôpky cesta a peč na miernom ohni asi 2 minúty, kým sa na povrchu neurobia bublinky. Otoč a dopeč ešte minútu.
steps.en: Lightly oil a pan, drop in small spoonfuls of batter and cook over low heat for about 2 minutes until bubbles appear on top. Flip and cook for one more minute.

steps.sk: Lievance natri džemom a podľa chuti posyp práškovým cukrom.
steps.en: Spread with jam and dust with powdered sugar if you like.

title.sk: Kôprová omáčka s vajíčkom a zemiakmi
title.en: Dill sauce with eggs and potatoes

description.sk: Jemná mliečno-kôprová omáčka, aká sa varí u starej mamy.
description.en: A gentle creamy dill sauce like the ones grandmothers make.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na väčšie kusy a var v osolenej vode 20 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes, cut into large pieces and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo, schlaď ich v studenej vode a ošúp.
steps.en: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until hard, cool them in cold water and peel.

steps.sk: Na masle krátko opraž múku, kým nezavonia, ale nezmení farbu. Postupne vlievaj studené mlieko a miešaj metličkou, aby nevznikli hrudky.
steps.en: Cook the flour in the butter briefly until fragrant but not coloured. Gradually whisk in the cold milk so no lumps form.

steps.sk: Omáčku za stáleho miešania povar 5 minút, kým nezhustne, a dochuť soľou, cukrom a octom.
steps.en: Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, stirring, until thickened, then season with salt, sugar and vinegar.

steps.sk: Odstav, vmiešaj nasekaný kôpor a podávaj so zemiakmi a rozpolenými vajíčkami.
steps.en: Take off the heat, stir in the chopped dill and serve with the potatoes and halved eggs.

description.sk: Bravčové mäso dusené s kyslou kapustou a smotanou.
description.en: Pork braised with sauerkraut and sour cream.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatista, asi 8 minút.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onions in the oil until golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso nakrájané na kocky a opeč ho zo všetkých strán. Stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj papriku a rascu.
steps.en: Add the diced pork and brown it on all sides. Take off the heat and stir in the paprika and caraway.

steps.sk: Podlej 300 ml vody, osoľ a nechaj prikryté dusiť 40 minút.
steps.en: Add 300 ml water and the salt and braise covered for 40 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú kyslú kapustu a nechaj dusiť ďalších 25 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Medzitým uvar ošúpané zemiaky.
steps.en: Add the rinsed sauerkraut and braise for another 25 minutes until the pork is tender. Meanwhile, boil the peeled potatoes.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s múkou, vmiešaj do gulášu a povar 3 minúty. Podávaj so zemiakmi.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the flour, stir into the goulash and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve with the potatoes.

title.en: Slovak potato bake with eggs and sausage

description.sk: Zapekané vrstvy zemiakov, vajíčok a klobásy so smotanou.
description.en: Baked layers of potatoes, eggs and sausage with sour cream.

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke takmer doměkka, asi 20 minút, a vajcia var 9 minút natvrdo. Všetko ošúp.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins until almost tender, about 20 minutes, and hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Peel everything.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Zemiaky a vajcia nakrájaj na kolieska, klobásu na tenké plátky a cibuľu nadrobno.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the potatoes and eggs, slice the sausage thinly and finely chop the onion.

steps.sk: Zapekaciu misu vymaž maslom a vrstvi zemiaky, vajcia, klobásu a cibuľu; každú vrstvu zemiakov osoľ a okoreň. Začni aj skonči zemiakmi.
steps.en: Butter a baking dish and layer potatoes, eggs, sausage and onion, salting and peppering each potato layer. Start and finish with potatoes.

steps.sk: Kyslú smotanu rozmiešaj s mliekom, rovnomerne polej a peč 35 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatistý.
steps.en: Whisk the sour cream with the milk, pour evenly over the top and bake for 35 minutes until golden.

description.sk: Hustá a dymová polievka na chladné dni.
description.en: A thick, smoky soup for cold days.

steps.sk: V hrnci na oleji opeč nakrájanú cibuľu a klobásu, asi 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the chopped onion and sausage in the oil, about 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou, krátko opraž, stiahni z ohňa a vmiešaj papriku.
steps.en: Dust with the flour, fry briefly, take off the heat and stir in the paprika.

steps.sk: Zalej 1,5 l vody, pridaj nakrájanú mrkvu a zemiaky, bobkové listy a soľ a var 15 minút.
steps.en: Add 1.5 l water, the sliced carrots and diced potatoes, the bay leaves and salt and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú fazuľu, cesnak a majorán a var ešte 10 minút. Dochuť octom a podávaj s lyžicou kyslej smotany.
steps.en: Add the rinsed beans, garlic and marjoram and simmer for 10 more minutes. Season with vinegar and serve with a spoonful of sour cream.

description.sk: Lacná, sýta a úplne rastlinná polievka zo špajze.
description.en: A cheap, filling and fully plant-based pantry soup.

steps.sk: Hrach prepláchni a zalej 1,3 l vody. Pridaj bobkový list a var 40 minút, kým nezmäkne.
steps.en: Rinse the peas, cover with 1.3 l water, add the bay leaf and simmer for 40 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Na 2 lyžiciach oleja speň cibuľu, pridaj ju do polievky so zemiakmi a mrkvou a var ďalších 15 minút.
steps.en: Soften the onion in 2 tablespoons of oil, add it to the soup with the potatoes and carrot and simmer for 15 more minutes.

steps.sk: Vyber bobkový list, pridaj cesnak, majorán a soľ a polievku rozmixuj dohladka.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaf, add the garlic, marjoram and salt and blend the soup until smooth.

steps.sk: Chlieb nakrájaj na kocky, opeč na zvyšnom oleji a podávaj s polievkou.
steps.en: Cut the bread into cubes, toast in the remaining oil and serve with the soup.

description.sk: Čistý zeleninový vývar s mäsom a rezancami, ktorý pomôže pri prechladnutí.
description.en: A clear vegetable broth with chicken and noodles, a comfort when you have a cold.

steps.sk: Mäso daj do hrnca s 2 l studenej vody, priveď do varu a zbieraj penu.
steps.en: Put the chicken in a pot with 2 l cold water, bring to the boil and skim off the foam.

steps.sk: Pridaj rozpolenú cibuľu, nové korenie, bobkový list a soľ a mierne var 40 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké.
steps.en: Add the halved onion, allspice, bay leaf and salt and simmer gently for 40 minutes until the chicken is tender.

steps.sk: Pridaj zeleninu nakrájanú na kolieska a kocky a var 15 minút. Mäso vyber, natrhaj a vráť do polievky.
steps.en: Add the sliced and diced vegetables and simmer for 15 minutes. Take the chicken out, shred it and return it to the soup.

steps.sk: Rezance uvar zvlášť v osolenej vode, aby polievka zostala číra. Podávaj s petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Cook the noodles separately in salted water so the broth stays clear. Serve with parsley.

description.sk: Orieškovo voňajúca pohánka s opečenými hubami – rastlinná a lacná.
description.en: Nutty buckwheat with fried mushrooms: plant-based and cheap.

steps.sk: Pohánku prepláchni, nasucho ju 2 minúty praž v hrnci, zalej 400 ml vody s bujónom, prikry a var na miernom ohni 15 minút.
steps.en: Rinse the buckwheat, toast it in a dry pot for 2 minutes, add 400 ml water with the stock cube, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým na oleji opeč cibuľu do zlatista, pridaj nakrájané huby a rascu a opekaj 8 minút, kým sa neodparí voda.
steps.en: Meanwhile, fry the onions in the oil until golden, add the sliced mushrooms and caraway and fry for 8 minutes until the liquid evaporates.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak a korenie a zmiešaj s pohánkou. Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Add the garlic and pepper and mix with the buckwheat. Sprinkle with parsley.

description.sk: Vianočná klasika z krúp a sušených húb s cesnakom a majoránom.
description.en: A Christmas classic of pearl barley, dried mushrooms, garlic and marjoram.

steps.sk: Hríby namoč do 300 ml horúcej vody na 20 minút. Krúpy prepláchni a var v osolenej vode 25 minút doměkka, sceď.
steps.en: Soak the mushrooms in 300 ml hot water for 20 minutes. Rinse the barley and boil in salted water for 25 minutes until tender, then drain.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Na oleji speň cibuľu, pridaj nasekané hríby aj s vodou a nechaj 10 minút dusiť.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Soften the onions in the oil, add the chopped mushrooms with their water and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj s krúpami, prelisovaným cesnakom, majoránom, rascou, soľou a korením.
steps.en: Mix with the barley, crushed garlic, marjoram, caraway, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Prelož do vymastenej misy a peč 25 minút, kým povrch nezačne chrumkať.
steps.en: Transfer to an oiled dish and bake for 25 minutes until the top turns crisp.

description.sk: Papriky plnené mäsom a ryžou v sladkokyslej paradajkovej omáčke.
description.en: Peppers stuffed with meat and rice in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.

steps.sk: Ryžu var 8 minút, sceď a nechaj vychladnúť. Paprikám odrež vrchnáky a vyber jadrovníky.
steps.en: Boil the rice for 8 minutes, drain and let it cool. Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s ryžou, vajcom, nastrúhanou cibuľou, cesnakom, paprikou, 1 lyžičkou soli a korením a naplň ním papriky.
steps.en: Mix the meat with the rice, egg, grated onion, garlic, paprika, 1 teaspoon of salt and the pepper and fill the peppers.

steps.sk: Passatu zrieď 300 ml vody, pridaj cukor a zvyšnú soľ, vlož papriky a prikryté var na miernom ohni 45 minút.
steps.en: Dilute the passata with 300 ml water, add the sugar and remaining salt, put in the peppers and simmer covered over low heat for 45 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäsová plnka musí byť v strede prepečená (75 °C), bez ružovej farby. Múku rozmiešaj v troche vody, zahusti omáčku a povar 5 minút.
steps.en: The filling must be cooked through in the centre (75 °C) with no pink. Whisk the flour with a little water, thicken the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi alebo knedľou.
steps.en: Serve with potatoes or bread dumplings.

title.sk: Kuracie prsia na prírodno s ryžou a hráškom
title.en: Pan-roasted chicken breast with rice and peas

description.sk: Jednoduché ľahké jedlo s množstvom bielkovín – klasika školských jedální, ale šťavnatá.
description.en: A simple, light, protein-rich meal: a school canteen classic, only juicy.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu podľa návodu; posledné 3 minúty k nej pridaj hrášok.
steps.en: Cook the rice according to the packet, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Prsia rozkroj na tenšie plátky, osoľ, okoreň a z jednej strany poprás múkou.
steps.en: Slice the breasts into thinner fillets, season and dust one side with flour.

steps.sk: Na masle ich opeč múkou nadol 4 minúty, otoč a opekaj ďalšie 3 minúty.
steps.en: Fry in the butter floured side down for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 3 more minutes.

steps.sk: Podlej 150 ml vody s rozpusteným bujónom a povar 3 minúty, kým mäso nie je vnútri biele (74 °C) a šťava nezhustne.
steps.en: Add 150 ml water with the dissolved stock cube and simmer for 3 minutes until the chicken is white inside (74 °C) and the juices thicken.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou a hráškom, prelej šťavou.
steps.en: Serve with the rice and peas and spoon over the juices.

description.sk: Lacný a jemný prívarok, ktorý chutí ako u starej mamy.
description.en: A cheap, gentle stew that tastes like a grandmother's.

steps.sk: Kel nakrájaj na rezance a zemiaky na kocky. Var ich v 800 ml osolenej vody s rascou 15 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Shred the cabbage and dice the potatoes. Simmer them in 800 ml salted water with the caraway for 15 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Na oleji urob svetlú zápražku z múky a rozmiešaj ju s mliekom.
steps.en: Make a pale roux from the flour in the oil and whisk in the milk.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj do kelu, pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, majorán a korenie a povar 5 minút, kým nezhustne.
steps.en: Stir it into the cabbage, add the crushed garlic, marjoram and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Podávaj samotný alebo s volským okom.
steps.en: Serve as it is or with a fried egg.

title.sk: Strapačky s kyslou kapustou a slaninou
title.en: Potato dumplings with sauerkraut and bacon

description.sk: Sestra bryndzových halušiek – s dusenou kyslou kapustou.
description.en: The sister of bryndza dumplings, with braised sauerkraut.

steps.sk: Slaninu nakrájaj na kocky a vyškvar ju, pridaj cibuľu a opekaj 4 minúty.
steps.en: Dice the bacon and render it, add the onion and fry for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj prepláchnutú kyslú kapustu, rascu, korenie a 100 ml vody a nechaj prikryté dusiť 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the rinsed sauerkraut, caraway, pepper and 100 ml water and braise covered for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Medzitým z nastrúhaných zemiakov, vajca, múky a soli vymiešaj cesto a halušky hádž do vriacej osolenej vody.
steps.en: Meanwhile, mix the grated potatoes, egg, flour and salt into a dough and drop dumplings into boiling salted water.

steps.sk: Keď vyplávajú, var ich ešte 2 minúty, sceď a zmiešaj s kapustou.
steps.en: Once they float, cook for 2 more minutes, drain and toss with the sauerkraut.

description.sk: Zemiakové knedle plnené slivkami, obalené v maslovej strúhanke.
description.en: Potato dumplings filled with plums and rolled in buttery breadcrumbs.

note.en: boiled in their skins and cooled

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke, ošúp, vychladnuté najemno nastrúhaj a s múkou, vajcom a soľou vypracuj vláčne cesto.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel, grate finely once cool and knead with the flour, egg and salt into a soft dough.

steps.sk: Slivkám vyber kôstky a do každej daj trochu cukru so škoricou.
steps.en: Stone the plums and put a little sugar with cinnamon into each one.

steps.sk: Cesto rozdeľ na 12 kúskov, každý roztlač, zabaľ doň slivku a uzavri do gule.
steps.en: Divide the dough into 12 pieces, flatten each, wrap around a plum and seal into a ball.

steps.sk: Var v osolenej vode 8 až 10 minút od vyplávania.
steps.en: Simmer in salted water for 8–10 minutes after they float.

steps.sk: Strúhanku opraž na masle dozlatista a obaľ v nej knedle. Podávaj posypané práškovým cukrom.
steps.en: Toast the breadcrumbs in the butter until golden and roll the dumplings in them. Serve dusted with powdered sugar.

description.sk: Chrumkavý rezeň opečený na panvici – najlepší so zemiakovým šalátom.
description.en: A crisp pan-fried schnitzel, best with potato salad.

steps.sk: Prsia rozkroj na tenké plátky a medzi fóliou ich naklep na 1 cm. Osoľ.
steps.en: Slice the breasts into thin escalopes and pound them to 1 cm between sheets of film. Salt them.

steps.sk: Obaľ ich postupne v múke, rozšľahaných vajciach a strúhanke.
steps.en: Coat them in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.

steps.sk: Na rozpálenom oleji vyprážaj 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a mäso vnútri biele (74 °C).
steps.en: Fry in hot oil for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and white inside (74 °C).

steps.sk: Nechaj odkvapkať na papierovej utierke a podávaj s citrónom.
steps.en: Drain on kitchen paper and serve with lemon.

description.sk: Vianočný zemiakový šalát so zeleninou, uhorkami a jogurtovo-majonézovým dresingom.
description.en: The Christmas potato salad with vegetables, pickles and a yogurt-mayonnaise dressing.

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke doměkka, asi 25 minút. Mrkvu a petržlen var 15 minút a vajcia 9 minút natvrdo.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender, about 25 minutes. Boil the carrots and parsley root for 15 minutes and the eggs for 9 minutes.

steps.sk: Všetko nechaj vychladnúť, ošúp a nakrájaj na drobné kocky spolu s uhorkami a cibuľou. Hrášok krátko spar.
steps.en: Let everything cool, peel and dice finely together with the pickles and onion. Blanch the peas briefly.

steps.sk: Majonézu zmiešaj s jogurtom, horčicou, soľou, korením a trochou nálevu z uhoriek.
steps.en: Mix the mayonnaise with the yogurt, mustard, salt, pepper and a little pickle brine.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj so zeleninou a nechaj aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke odležať. Vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Toss with the vegetables and chill for at least 2 hours. Keeps for 3 days.
